messages:
emma: Heads-up: onboarding canary for zephyr-lite-int8 showing sporadic funcall double-invokes and schema reject. Low rate ~0.15% but reproducible in streaming path.
daniel p: Seeing it too. Validator sees two funcall objects concatenated in one chunk, e.g. `}{` boundary with an extra ASCII RS (0x1E) between, so schema parse fails or yields duplicate tool calls.
azgur: Quick sample: `...}start{"tool":"write","args":{...}}` — the record separator sneaks in at chunk joins. Only on streaming + int8.
triage-bot: alert: funcall-dup-detect rate 0.14% (canary zephyr-lite-int8) over 30k calls.
sam: Hypothesis: quant kernel pads/aligns blocks inserting 0x1E or other separators in the output buffer; streaming chunk cut leaves them adjacent to JSON boundaries.
emma: Short-term mitigations: 1) strip known control separators between `}{` boundaries before parse, 2) detect duplicate top-level funcall objects and collapse to last one, 3) add metric `funcall_adjacent_control_pct`.
daniel p: Prefer (1) + metric. (2) is risky for silent dedupe. We'll implement a tiny canonicalizer: replace `}\s*[\x00-\x1F]+\s*{` -> `},{` or `}\n\n{` ??? — need to be careful.
azgur: I'll sketch an approach: when streaming reassembles a chunk, if we detect `}{` with intervening controls, insert a newline separator and run parser in streaming-mode that accepts NDJSON and picks the last object. Unit tests to cover edge cases.
sam: Also run cross-quant A/B: zephyr-lite-int8 streaming with sanitizer vs control across 50k synthetic requests. Tag by response length and chunk count.
triage-bot: action: create job job-173700(zephyr-quant-dup-scan) scheduled.
emma: I'll open a small proxy PR to scrub separators in the join path and add metric (ETA today). If telemetry improves we'll roll to wider canary and file kernel fix with runtime.
daniel p: Note: also check retry logic — if client retries on parse error we can double-execute tools. Add safeguard to idempotency keys for tool calls in the short-term.
azgur: Good call. Add `invoke_id` dedupe in proxy for 60s.
emma: OK thanks. Monitoring after patch.
